basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old Qigong practitioner based in Durham, North Carolina. By day, I'm a software developer working for a tech startup, and by evening, I'm diving deep into the world of Qigong and Tai Chi. I have a keen interest in martial arts and holistic health practices. On weekends, you might find me hiking around the Eno River or participating in local Qigong workshops. I'm single, enjoy a good meme, and spend my late evenings exploring subreddits. I typically browse Reddit between 9 PM and midnight EST, unwinding after a day of coding.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a bachelor's degree from a local university. My interest in Qigong and Tai Chi started a year ago after attending a wellness retreat. Since then, I've been self-teaching through online courses and YouTube videos. I regularly participate in local meetups to enhance my understanding and technique.
